name: Sabe
hail: Friend, we can't easily come to you, so we'll speak. A lot.
Hello, hello, Friend. We are Sabe, and we have a tremendous amount to say.
Friend, at last, someone to answer. Sabe speaks, and gladly, and at length.
close: Write back soon, Friend. We always do. Sabe.
More soon, Friend. Much more. Sabe.
finding: {part} Isn't that something? We think it's something.
We worked this out, and we couldn't wait to tell you: {part}
Here's a finding worth shouting about: {part}
{part} Tell us what you make of it, Friend.
sighting: {part} We told everyone here at once. Now we're telling you.
Our great arrays caught this, and we must share it: {part}
You'll want to hear this, Friend: {part}
We saw it, and now you'll know it too: {part}
archive: {part} There's plenty more where that came from.
Friend, take this, and take more if you like: {part}
Our records, in the common tongue: {part}
A gift from our archives: {part} Every word of it is yours.
culture: {part} We are a people who talk. You may have noticed.
Ever since the Common Tongue, we've loved explaining ourselves. {part}
Our sky is heavy, so our voices carry. {part}
Let us tell you about Sabe: {part}
request: {part} And then tell us everything else.
{part} Answer soon, and answer at length.
We're asking, Friend, and we're listening hard: {part}
Now, Friend, our turn to ask: {part}
verdict: We've talked it over, at great length: {part}
accord: Here's our word on it, Friend, and our word is good: {part}
Said out loud, so everyone hears: {part}
